vercel.reason: Root vercel.json only builds/deploys apps/web as a static bundle (confirmed passing locally). apps/api has no vercel.json, no build script, and no serverless-function adapter — it is a persistent @hono/node-server process, not deployable to Vercel as configured, and README.md documents this as intentional ('there is no Hono server behind the deployment'). The failing check targets a distinct Vercel project literally named animation-test-chamber-api, which appears to be a second project pointed at this repo without a compatible build configuration for apps/api. Not fixable from the repository without adding a serverless adapter, which would be a deployment-architecture redesign outside this work package's scope and contrary to the repository's documented design.
